label: Dapr: secret retrieval
info: Reads one secret on demand. Set the connection node's Dapr host/port and app port before deploying. This flow uses a secret store named "vault" -- see examples/README.md for a real backing component with that name. The result lands on the configured Property (msg.payload by default). The node does not attach the key or value to its generated status, errors, or secret boundary span, but user-authored node names and daprd's own logs and traces can contain the key. This example replaces the value with a boolean before Debug.

name: redact before debug
func:
msg.payload = { retrieved: msg.payload !== null };
return msg;
